Experience Range (only)-23-29 yrs


Solution Architect/Enterprise Architect

Location: India
Company: EPAM Systems

About EPAM

EPAM is a leading global provider of digital transformation services, consulting, and engineering solutions. We work with Fortune 500 companies and global enterprises to deliver next-generation platforms and managed services. We are seeking a Lead Solution Architect (Director-level) who combines deep technical knowledge, leadership of large-scale managed services programs, and the ability to engage senior business stakeholders.

This role is ideal for a strategic thinker and hands-on technologist who can inspire teams, shape enterprise architectures, and drive business outcomes in complex global delivery environments.

Role Overview

As a Lead Enterprise/Solution Architect at EPAM, you will play a dual role as a technology leader and client partner. You will lead solution strategy, oversee architecture governance, and manage large-scale managed services engagements. You will directly interact with CXO-level stakeholders to define transformation roadmaps while guiding and mentoring teams of architects and engineers to deliver excellence.

Key Responsibilities

  • Enterprise Architecture & Strategy
    • Define and own the solution strategy for large-scale digital transformation and managed services programs.
    • Drive multi-year technology roadmaps, modern platform architectures, and operating models.
    • Ensure solutions are scalable, resilient, cost-efficient, and aligned with business objectives.
  • Managed Services Leadership
    • Architect and oversee large-scale managed services engagements, including application management, cloud operations, and platform engineering.
    • Define SLAs, governance models, performance monitoring, and continuous improvement frameworks.
    • Ensure operational excellence through automation, AI/GenAI, and DevOps-driven practices.
  • Hands-On Technical Leadership
    • Stay hands-on with architecture, proof-of-concepts, and technology exploration.
    • Lead technical due diligence, solution assessments, and modernization strategies.
    • Advocate for innovation, including cloud-native, microservices, event-driven architectures, and AI/GenAI-enabled solutions.
  • Client Advisory & Stakeholder Engagement
    • Act as a trusted advisor to CIOs, CTOs, and other CXO-level executives.
    • Bridge business strategy with technology execution, presenting clear roadmaps and business cases.
    • Lead pre-sales, RFP/RFI responses, and executive-level presentations to secure new business opportunities.
  • Team Leadership & Talent Development
    • Lead a community of solution architects, principal engineers, and delivery leads across multiple geographies.
    • Foster a culture of technical excellence, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning.
    • Mentor senior architects on architecture best practices, client engagement, and managed services solutioning.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 23+ years of experience in software engineering, enterprise architecture, and solution design.
  • Proven track record in leading large-scale managed services programs (multi-year, multi-million-dollar engagements).
  • Deep knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), enterprise integration, and platform modernization.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one programming language (Java, .NET, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Python).
  • Strong expertise in service delivery models, SLAs/KPIs, and governance frameworks.
  • Experience with AI/GenAI integration in managed services (automation, predictive analytics, conversational AI, knowledge management).
  • Demonstrated ability to interact with and influence CXO-level executives.
  • Proven experience in IT consulting or global delivery organizations.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and presentation skills.

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with AIOps, MLOps, and intelligent automation.
  • Knowledge of GenAI orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock).
  • Strong business acumen to participate in contract negotiations, service pricing, and P&L discussions.
  • Thought leadership (public speaking, whitepapers, or blogs in architecture and AI/GenAI).

Why EPAM?

  • Lead strategic client partnerships at the intersection of technology, business, and operations.
  • Influence technology direction for some of the worlds largest enterprises.
  • Drive large-scale, multi-tower managed services programs with cutting-edge automation and GenAI.
  • Join a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous growth.

Director - Technology
Location: Noida, UP, India
Job Summary
Role Overview: Seeking an accomplished AI GenAI Architecture Leader with deep expertise in Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Agentic AI, Full-Stack Engineering, and Enterprise Architecture. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of conceptualizing, designing, prototyping, and scaling AI-powered solutions from PoC and experimentation phases through enterprise production deployment.

  • Assess technical feasibility and complexity of incoming use cases in collaboration with the AI Delivery Governance Lead.

  • Conduct code reviews and provide technical guidance to Senior AI Engineers and AI Engineers.
  • Mentor the engineering team on agent design patterns, prompt engineering best practices, and production deployment.
  • Represent the SMBS AI team in technical discussions with the Platform team, contributing to and consuming shared orchestration standards.
  • Code on complex agent implementations, particularly during initial solution setup and technically challenging use cases.
  • Build proof-of-concept implementations to validate solution decisions before full engineering commitment.
  • Contribute to production code on critical paths while maintaining oversight of the broader technical portfolio.
What We Value
  • Deep practical experience with LLM-based agent frameworks.
  • 7+ years of experience in production AI/ML engineering, with at least 3 years in a technical lead capacity.
  • Deep software engineering fundamentals in Python and modern development practices.
  • Experience designing RAG pipelines, prompt engineering strategies, and multi-agent orchestration patterns.
  • Demonstrated experience building and leading high-performing engineering teams, with the ability to develop talent and maintain technical standards across the team.
  • You have a bias for delivery you deliver quickly without compromising on quality, and you know how to get a solution from proof of concept to production.
  • Ability to make solution decisions that balance innovation with maintainability and production reliability.
  • Experience working in financial services or other regulated industries preferred.
  • Effective communication skills to engage with both engineering peers and non-technical stakeholders.

Be an Entrepreneur Manager • Own a Market

GTM Leader • US Market • Extensive US Travel


Locations: Bengaluru • Hyderabad • Gurugram • Pune • Chennai


About AIONOS

AIONOS (pronounced aye-yo-nos) is an AI-native technology company that builds and operates enterprise AI for industries. Founded in 2024 and headquartered in Singapore, AIONOS is a joint venture between InterGlobe Enterprises and Assago Group, bringing together deep enterprise technology expertise and sector-defining operational experience. With live operations across the USA, UK, Europe, the Middle East, Japan, APAC, ANZ, and India, the company deploys a workforce of 2,500+ AI engineers, domain specialists, and practitioners across Aviation, Travel & Hospitality, Logistics, Telecom, BFSI, and Healthcare. Powered by its proprietary AI enterprise stack, AIONOS delivers measurable business outcomes through an accountable, human-in-the-loop model that sits on top of existing enterprise investments.


For more information, visit www.aionos.ai


Job Summary

Own origination, pipeline, and revenue across Global Capability Centers. You bring your own accounts, we add a named list, and you run pursuits end to end while advising clients on setting up, scaling, and transforming their GCCs. You will sell AIONOS's full service line: Strategy, Consulting, Technology, Data and AI, Cloud, SAP, Security.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own revenue for your accounts. Build qualified pipeline and grow wallet share.
  • Carry and deliver the number. Inside sales supports the top of the funnel, but attainment sits with you. Set account priorities, brief the inside sales executives, and source your own meetings where coverage falls short.
  • Run large pursuits spanning multiple service lines, from qualification through commercial negotiation and closure.
  • Map GCCs to their US parent companies to find warm entry points.
  • Represent AIONOS at GCC forums, industry events, and client roundtables, and feed market and competitive intelligence back into growth strategy.
  • Work across Client Groups, Industry teams, and Global Sales on integrated account strategies.

Must Have Skills

Experience

  • 7 to 10 years of enterprise technology consulting or sales experience, selling Digital, Cloud, Data and AI, or large transformation programmes into Travel, Transport, Logistics, BFSI, or Telecom clients.
  • A live rolodex inside existing GCCs in these verticals. You should be able to open doors in weeks, not quarters.
  • Deals run end to end: account mining, pipeline creation, CXO relationships, commercial negotiation.

Hunting and demand generation

  • Hardcore outbound to US and India enterprise buyers, including cold outreach and meetings you sourced yourself. Be ready to walk us through your prospecting method and how many connects became meetings.
  • Able to direct inside sales effort with sharp targeting, clear messaging, and tight follow up, while still picking up the phone yourself.
  • A quota you have carried and hit. Bring the target, the achievement, the percentage, and the period for your last two or three cycles. We will ask.

Thinking and initiative

  • Finds ways into accounts that others miss, and builds an offer around the client's real problem instead of a standard service pitch.
  • Works without being managed. Reads account data, org charts, and market signals to decide where to spend time, then tells a story good enough to get a meeting. We are screening for initiative and follow through, not credentials.

Travel

  • Roughly half the year in the US, on a cycle of 15 days in India followed by 15 days in the US. Valid passport required, US visa preferred.

Good to Have

  • Background at a Tier 1 consulting or systems integration firm.
  • Existing relationships with NASSCOM chapter heads or the GCC Council.
  • Experience managing strategic global accounts and complex pursuits with many stakeholders.
  • Sales certification covering the full sales motion from prospecting to closing. Salesforce Certified Agentforce Sales Foundations preferred. HubSpot Academy or LinkedIn Learning equivalents also relevant.

Education

Bachelor's degree required. MBA or PGDM from a premier institute preferred.

Job Summary
The establishment of a GDS Digital Engineering Leader for TMT is critical to accelerate EY GDS Consultings growth in a sector experiencing rapid, technology-led disruption and innovation. TMT clients, including telecommunications service providers, digital media companies, streaming platforms, software and hardware technology firms, and emerging tech innovators are significantly increasing investments in platform and product engineering, cloud-native modernization, AI-enabled software development lifecycle (SDLC) transformation, digital content and data platforms,
OSS/BSS modernization, 5G/6G networks and edge computing, and cyberresilient engineering.
While demand is robust, GDS participation today tends to be capabilityspecific and opportunity-driven, which limits the ability to present a cohesive, end-to-end Digital Engineering value proposition tailored to the unique challenges and fast-paced evolution of the TMT landscape. This role provides dedicated executive leadership to transition from fragmented delivery models to a solution-led, engineering-centric approach, enhancing GDS integration, improving win-rates, and ensuring delivery predictability across TMT sub-sectors.
Essential Functions
  • Build strong relationships with TMT sector leaders, account leaders, and EY Member Firms to influence account plans and drive growth.
  • Establish a solution and FieldofPlaybased operating model for TMT Digital Engineering (product & platform engineering, cloud modernization, integration/API ecosystems, DevSecOps, QA automation, SRE).
  • Ensure GDS participation in large technology and transformation deals, supporting solution shaping, pricing, estimates, and RFP responses.
  • Participate in and lead key client orals, demonstrating EY/GDS engineering capability, assets, and delivery excellence.
  • Host CXOlevel client visits to GDS to showcase engineering studios, accelerators, innovation, and rightshoring models.
  • Build scalable rightshoring delivery models, leveraging offshore and nearshore strengths while ensuring reliability and compliance.
  • Establish delivery governance across pipeline, demand, delivery health, and cost of delivery.
  • Build and mentor an engineering leadership bench (SM/EDs) aligned to priority TMT portfolios.
  • Drive strategic collaboration with key technology partners, startups, and academic institutions within the TMT ecosystem to co-create cutting-edge engineering solutions and accelerate digital transformation across TMT sectors.
  • Ensure all engineering solutions and delivery practices within EY GDS adhere to TMT industry-specific regulatory requirements, safety standards,and cybersecurity protocols, maintaining the highest standards of compliance and risk management.

The primary work location for this role is Trivandrum with a hybrid work model.
Envestnet is an adaptive WealthTech company that is redefining the future of wealth management by helping advisors meet the moment with its comprehensive technology, actionable insights, and industry leading support. Job Summary

The Senior Director, Head Launch Excellence is a strategic and operationally experienced serial launch leader in Amgen's Global Marketing organization, bringing pattern recognition from multiple biopharmaceutical launches to shape and run Launch Excellence (LEX) as a practical global launch operating capability.

This role partners across Global, Regional and Affiliate teams to establish an enterprise LEX capability as part of the Global with Local (GwL) model. The LEX lead will define hands-on, guided and self-service support levels, identify critical-path risks early and build the Launch Excellence capability in the Amgen India Capability Center (AIN), including AI-enabled automation for repeatable launch activities.

Location

Location / Travel: We are posting this role in multiple locations including US, India, Europe. Travel expected ~0-20%.

Key Responsibilities
  • LEX Operating Model Leadership: Define and operationalize the LEX operating model, including launch-clock scope, global-to-local handoffs, governance, decision rights, service levels and escalation paths.
  • Launch Readiness Standards Launch Judgment: Set quality standards for launch readiness planning, milestone preparation, LRRs, leadership touchpoints, risk and decision logs and launch performance, using serial launch judgment to pressure-test plans.
  • Global-to-Local Marketing Integration: Partner with Global teams, ABM, regions and affiliates to translate launch strategy into high-quality launch preparation, integrated launch plans and practical market activation support. Partner with Marketing and ABM teams to identify and close launch-specific guidance and process gaps.
  • Service-Level Market Archetype Management: Implement clear rules for hands-on, guided and self-service LEX support based on brand priority, market relevance, launch complexity, critical-path risk and escalation triggers.
  • AIN Capability Center Leadership: Hire, onboard and manage the AIN Launch Excellence team, setting role clarity, intake processes, service menus, quality expectations and ways of working with Global, Regional and Market teams. This team acts as the scalable delivery engine for LEX, with clear interfaces to Global, Regional and Market stakeholders.
  • Tools, Templates AI Enablement: Build and maintain practical LEX assets such as launch dashboards, LRR tools, quality checks, GM checklists, self-assessments, KPI dictionary, playbooks and AI-enabled workflows.
  • Governance, Reporting Risk Management: Establish launch readiness routines, readiness heatmaps, KPI definitions, risk triggers, decision records and escalation mechanisms that give senior leaders clear visibility into launch readiness and trade-offs.
  • Learning Loop Capability Building: Develop onboarding, learning modules, communities of practice, reusable launch cases, after-action reviews and post-launch retrospectives so learnings scale across brands and markets. Establish global launch forums to share lessons learned, and best practices across brands, accelerating cross-brand learning for teams working toward similar launch timelines.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Build trusted relationships with global, regional and local leaders, ensuring LEX improves launch quality and focus without becoming a substitute for brand strategy ownership or local accountability.


Core Competencies
  • Serial launch leadership: Proven pattern recognition from multiple biopharmaceutical launches, with the ability to pressure-test plans, anticipate risks and know what good readiness looks like across launch types and markets.
  • Global and local marketing expertise: Deep experience across global brand strategy, regional translation and local execution, ideally across launch, in-line and lifecycle brands.
  • People leadership: Demonstrated success hiring, leading and developing teams, ideally including offshore or capability-center teams.
  • Strategic and operational judgment: Ability to connect brand strategy, launch sequencing, market needs, governance, milestones and execution into a practical operating model.
  • Stakeholder influence: Strong credibility with senior leaders and ability to align Global, Regional and Market stakeholders without relying on formal authority.
  • Pragmatic innovation mindset: Ability to apply AI, automation, dashboards and knowledge management to improve speed, quality and reuse.


Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Extensive biopharmaceutical commercial experience, ideally 22 - 26 years across global, regional and local marketing and commercial roles.
  • Demonstrated serial launch track record: personally led, shaped or played a senior cross-functional role in multiple product launches across brands, markets and launch archetypes.
  • Direct experience leading launch excellence, launch readiness, launch operations or multi-market execution, including integrated launch plans, critical-path milestones, risk mitigation and launch governance.
  • Proven people management experience, including building teams, setting operating models and coaching talent in complex matrix environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to engage senior stakeholders, influence across functions and communicate clearly with executive audiences.
  • Strong project management, organizational and analytical skills, with comfort using dashboards, KPIs and risk-based decision-making.
  • Experience with digital tools, dashboards, AI-enabled workflows or automation in commercial operations, launch readiness or launch execution preferred.

ABOUT THE ROLE
Role Description:
The Senior Manager Information Security, Digital Forensics (DF) leads the DF Hyderabad team within Digital Forensics. This on site leader manages investigators, coordinates with the India office, and works closely with the Security Operations Center (SOC), Tier 2 Security Operations, Incident Response (IR), Legal, Compliance, Privacy, Human Resources (HR), and electronic discovery (eDiscovery) stakeholders. The role is leadership first in addition to performing investigations and eDiscovery. The successful candidate must have the technical judgment to guide investigations, review findings, challenge unsupported conclusions, protect evidence, and support high risk cyber, legal, and HR escalations. The role also guides workflows across EnCase, Nuix, Forensic Toolkit (FTK), Monolith Pro, Cellebrite, CrowdStrike Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), IBM QRadar Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), Microsoft Office 365 (O365), Amazon Web Services (AWS), and ServiceNow. This leader will also help mature automation, Artificial Intelligence (AI) assisted analysis, and future agentic AI workflows in a controlled, human reviewed manner.
Roles Responsibilities:
  • Lead the Hyderabad DF team, including coaching, performance reviews, career development, workload planning, timekeeping, holiday approvals, and day to day people leadership.
  • Operate as the local DF leader for Hyderabad, partnering with the India office and Cybersecurity Operations while escalating high risk decisions at the right time.
  • Manage the handoff relationships between DF and the SOC, Tier 2 Security Operations and IR, including triage, escalation, case priority and service expectations.
  • Oversee investigations and support activities involving cyber incidents, insider risk, employee matters, eDiscovery, litigation hold, compliance requests, data exposure, unauthorized access, malware, phishing, ransomware, and suspected data exfiltration.
  • Partner with Legal, HR, Compliance, Privacy, Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI), Vulnerability Management Services (VMS), Penetration Testing, Cloud Engineering, Information Technology (IT), and business teams to scope, preserve, review, and report evidence.
  • Maintain evidence handling standards for Hyderabad, including authorized scope, chain of custody, hashing, secure storage, encrypted media, access control, case notes, evidence transfer, and cloud based analysis.
  • Maintain cloud and Software as a Service (SaaS) forensic readiness across O365 and AWS, preservation workflows, evidence handling and data analysis.
  • Guide DF workflow maturity across EnCase, Nuix, FTK, Monolith Pro, Cellebrite, CrowdStrike EDR, IBM QRadar SIEM, O365, AWS, and ServiceNow.
  • Advance responsible adoption of automation, AI assisted workflows, and future agentic AI capabilities with controls for approved data use, human review, source validation, audit logging, and least privilege access.
  • Review investigation strategy, final reports, and stakeholder communications for accuracy, evidence defensibility, confidentiality, and appropriate language.
  • Maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), playbooks, Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), cross training, tabletop exercises, and report quality review processes to support team growth and operational maturity.
Basic Qualifications and Experience:
  • Any degree and 12 to 17 years of information security, digital forensics, incident response, cybersecurity operations, cyber investigations, eDiscovery, or related field experience
  • Experience should include at least 3 years leading technical teams, managing technical workstreams, or operating as a site or regional leader in a global cybersecurity environment.
Functional Skills:
Must-Have Skills:
  • Leadership of DFIR, cyber investigations, evidence handling, and sensitive Legal, HR, Compliance, and eDiscovery matters.
  • Security operations escalation management with SOC, Tier 2 Security Operations, IR, CrowdStrike EDR, IBM QRadar SIEM, O365, AWS, and ServiceNow.
  • Strong understanding of forensic defensibility, chain of custody, cloud and SaaS evidence, privacy aware investigation scope, litigation hold, and report quality.
  • Experience improving investigation operations through automation, AI assisted analysis, scripting, queries, playbooks, metrics, or workflow design.
Good-to-Have Skills:
  • Hands on or oversight experience with EnCase, Nuix, FTK, Monolith Pro, Cellebrite, Microsoft Purview eDiscovery, AWS forensic workflows, and O365 evidence.
  • Knowledge of identity investigation, insider risk, data movement, endpoint artifacts, mobile forensics, email evidence, and cloud log analysis.
  • Experience creating regulated documents, SOPs, work instructions, evidence handling standards, tabletop exercises, and readiness playbooks.
  • Experience with scripting and query languages such as Python, PowerShell, Kusto Query Language (KQL), Ariel Query Language (AQL), Structured Query Language (SQL), Sigma, or YARA in a regulated global enterprise, consulting, government, or law enforcement cyber environment.
Professional Certifications:
  • One active cybersecurity, digital forensics, incident response, electronic discovery, cloud security, security leadership, mobile forensics, or forensic tool certification is required.
  • Strongly preferred certifications include Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC) Certified Forensic Analyst (GCFA), GIAC Certified Forensic Examiner (GCFE), GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), EnCase Certified Examiner (EnCE), Certified Computer Examiner (CCE), Certified Forensic Computer Examiner (CFCE), Certified Hacking Forensic Investigator (CHFI), Cellebrite Certified Physical Analyst (CCPA), Cellebrite Certified Mobile Examiner (CCME), Nuix certification, FTK certification, AWS Certified Security - Specialty, or Microsoft security and compliance certification.

  • Strong interpersonal skills with the confidence to challenge unsupported conclusions, unclear scope, or improper requests.
